objects.name: Merry
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The remains of the Merry, a Core fighter flown by lieutenant Jared Graham. A former LPI officer, Graham became infamous for daring interceptions and captures, often well outside usual LPI jurisdiction. Although showered in promotion and bonuses back home, Graham ended up looking for more, both challenge and money. This pursuit would lead Graham to join the Core paramilitary, soon climbing their ranks as a scout.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The ship appears to have suffered catastrophic damage in a collision with one of the surrounding asteroids. Based on local conditions, it is likely the heat and radiation blinded the pilot as they made their run across the field.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Surrounding the wreckage is a number of blackboxes and data drives, likely ejected from the ship during the collision. They have long since been rendered defunct by the environmental conditions.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Killjoy
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The remains of the Killjoy, a Core fighter flown by lieutenant Harvey Chapman. Once a Bounty Hunter of some renown, Chapman was known for his particular hatred towards the Liberty Insurgency and his many successful sorties deep into Vespucci itself. After the Insurgency fell, Chapman would travel Sirius, eventually ending up employed by the Core.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>With plenty of experience in the depths of the Walker Nebula and behind-enemy-lines operations, Chapman was a natural pick for the Edenvale Expedition’s security detail. Unfortunately, the Edenvale’s departure would be the last time Killjoy was seen or heard from.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The ship appears to have taken significant damage from both neutron and plasma weapons. The cockpit is little more than slag, likely hit with a spread of plasma projectiles at close range. Although the ship’s blackbox is damaged, a few partial data entries remain. The final entry suggests the Killjoy split off from its pack to take down an isolated enemy bomber.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Maulwurf 2
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The remains of Maulwurf 2, flown by Hugo Bergler. Once a veteran scout for the Rheinland Military, Bergler left military service for the Guild shortly after the Rheinland Civil War. He spent most of his career working security around Freistadt, escorting miners and prospectors across Omega-7 and Omega-3, using his inside knowledge of Military training and tactics to counter Daumann and Kruger raids against IMG operations in the region.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>His performance would eventually draw the attention of Sebastian Enzenauer, the flight leader of the infamous Maulwurf wing. Bergler would enlist with the wing just weeks before their ill-fated encounter with Daumann mercenaries. Blaming himself for the losses that day, it would be Bergler who pushed the other survivors to join the Hessians to get their revenge.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Manaslu appears to have been disabled by accurate particle weapons fire, most closely matching damage typically inflicted by APM-made weaponry. The onboard blackbox is largely intact, and analysis of the data entries indicate the Maulwurfs were trailing what they perceived to be a Corsair smuggling convoy. Bergler’s wingmen appear to have perished in the resulting skirmish, the Manaslu intercepted and crippled soon after by an unidentified Silvertip-class fighter.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Sibirskaya Brisa
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Sibirskaya Brisa was a Dromedary-class freighter under Coalition registry, captained by Anton Rykov, a grizzled transport pilot with years of service on contested frontiers. Though a civilian freighter by design, the vessel bore the signs of Coalition modification: heavier armor plating welded crudely along the hull, reinforced thrusters, and a jamming suite fitted into one of the cargo bays. Reports suggest the ship was ferrying supplies and possibly experimental equipment couriers when it entered Omega-2 under pursuit.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Local bounty hunter wings engaged the Brisa near the Omega-47 trade corridor. Rykov refused to yield, pushing the freighter at maximum thrust through the patrol net. The chase lasted hours, carrying both hunters and prey into increasingly sparse territory. When the freighter crossed the system’s outer edge, the bounty hunters broke off, unwilling to follow further into the Deep Omegas. The Brisa, however, did not stop.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Automated logs suggest the freighter drifted without corrective maneuvers for months, life support failing and fuel depleted. The wreck was eventually located embedded in a fractured asteroid field, hull breached by multiple impacts. No crew survived. Its lonely trajectory and final resting place remain a quiet testament to the stubborn refusal of its captain to be taken alive, even at the cost of wandering into regions from which no Coalition vessel has yet returned. With him, the new experimental weapon might be lost forever...</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Ammo and equipment isn't so much of a problem on an industrial planet. We can use the factories we still hold to manufacture more. The problem is with the more basic supplies. Consumer Goods used to be ordered in from London, and we were entirely reliant on Cambridge Food Rations. With the seige in place, we've got finite stockpiles that we're having to ration carefully. Once they're gone, things get... interesting. Hopefully the engineers will have some biopods up by then so we can grow stuff here. Much like on spacestations, if you recycle everything, the only thing you need is energy, and that's something we can manage on Leeds. </TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Bretonia Gunboat
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Many goods pass through the Ring on their way to distant lands. This facility serves as Daumann's transfer point for its various mining operations further afield in Dresden and the Omega systems. From here, Republican ships haul our minerals and finished goods to Kusari, Liberty, and Bretonia. </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Royal Engineer Minelayers
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Royal Engineers are a specialist unit of the Bretonia Armed Forces responsible for battlefield repairs, the laying and clearance of minefields, and the preparation of fixed defenses. Adapted Royal Engineer repair ships are being used to program and deploy mines around the Sommerset bridgehead in Dublin.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Gold was one of Bowex's largest and most lucrative exports. To say that it is imperative that the trade is resumed as soon as possible fails to capture the urgency of the issue. Fortunately BMM are already launching expeditions into the Graves Field, under armed guard.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
objects.infocard: New London Drive Breach

objects.name: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>A veteran cruiser of the Gallic War, the Leros accompanied the Battlecruiser Momus from Tau-44, for its deployment to Inverness. Following the withdrawal of the LSF's Tuscaloosa battlegroup in 835 AS, the Crayter Republic have been left to hold the line against "Vagrant" threats alone.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
objects.infocard: Lend-Lease Depot

objects.name: Santa Lucia
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>CLASS: Pilgrim</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>GRAVITY: Unknown</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>DOCKING: Yes</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>AMENITIES: Limited</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>CREW: 20</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Shannon
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Shannon was a Crecy class cruiser assigned to the Fifth Royal Cruiser Flotilla. She served throughout the Gallic War, and participated in the ill-fated Bretonian intervention into Vespucci during Liberty's campaign against the Insurgency. The Shannon was destroyed in Dublin with the detonation of the fire ship Fortune.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Gaviota
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The remains of the Gaviota, a Titan-class fighter flown by veteran raider Natalia Sa. Known for her daring raids deep behind Hessian lines, even as far as Stuttgart itself, Sa earned herself significant wealth and many commendations. Her fame and indisputable skill would earn her a place in the newly formed Cerbero squadron as its second in command.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Like the rest of the Cerbero squadron, Sa was last seen trailing a Core convoy through the southern Omega systems.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The remains of the vessel show signs of widespread, if superficial, damage, likely inflicted by fighter-grade weapons over the course of multiple engagements. As the ship’s structure remains sound, it is likely the killing blow was dealt against the cockpit with a precise burst of laser weapons fire.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Cerbero
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The wreckage of the Cerbero, a specially modified Correo-class freighter flown by Cleonico Cavaleri. A veteran of the Bretonian front, Cavaleri had a legendary reputation amongst the garrison of Leon, using his freighter to turn the tables on many Bretonian and Hessian pilots alike. His exploits would earn him extensive fame, so much so he would receive a special assignment from the Elders themselves.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Thus, in late 830 AS, Cavaleri was made the leader of a newly formed squadron. Comprised of other irregulars like himself, the squadron had a simple purpose - to give the Core a taste of their own medicine. As the corporate mercenaries entrenched themselves in the Omicron and Omega systems, the Elders had sensed an opportunity. With every raid and incursion, the Core amassed more and more wealth and exotic technologies, the valuable loot then shipped off to their customers among the Houses. Mirroring the Core’s own brazen tactics, Cavaleri and his squadron were tasked with hounding the mercenaries much like they did the Empire, utilizing quick smash-and-grab raids to take back what rightfully belonged to Crete.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The squadron’s career was as successful as it was short lived, however, as Cavaleri and his men went missing while shadowing a Core research ship in late 831 AS. Analysis of the wreckage indicates the Cerbero went through multiple engagements, suffering heavy damage from fighter-grade lasers and gunboat-grade particle weapons. The vessel’s fuel tanks are ruptured, the loss of fuel leaving the ship stranded over the uncharted world. The pilot’s body, equipment and any potential cargo are likely still onboard.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Ammo and equipment isn't so much of a problem on an industrial planet. We can use the factories we still hold to manufacture more. The problem is with the more basic supplies. Consumer Goods used to be ordered in from London, and we were entirely reliant on Cambridge Food Rations. With the seige in place, we've got finite stockpiles that we're having to ration carefully. Once they're gone, things get... interesting. Hopefully the engineers will have some biopods up by then so we can grow stuff here. Much like on spacestations, if you recycle everything, the only thing you need is energy, and that's something we can manage on Leeds. </TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Planet Timbuktu
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 10,870 km</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 6.78 x 10e24 kg</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Volcanic</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: 50°C to 1100°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 8.51 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Placed in the heart of Omega-97, Timbuktu is a world in constant turmoil. Its surface varies from regular rocks to molten rocks and turbulent volcanic eruptions. Born from a violent formation process within the thick nebula of the Deep Omegas, the planet was once a promising terrestrial body, rich in heavy elements and volatile compounds. However, gravitational interactions with a nearby rogue mass disrupted its internal balance, triggering runaway geological activity. Its mantle feeds a network of supervolcanoes that blot out the sky with fire and ash. Rivers of molten metal carve ever-shifting landscapes, while intense heat-driven windstorms, laden with sulfur and glass-like particulates, make any surface approach risky.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The planet’s composition is an unstable mix of iron-rich rock, silicates, and heavy trace elements, constantly recycled by its violent crust. Any water that may have existed was long since vaporized, its remnants lost to the turbulent nebula engulfing the system. The dense atmosphere is a toxic soup of carbon dioxide, sulfur dioxide, and trace hydrogen compounds, trapping heat and amplifying the planet’s destructive cycle. Long-range scans indicate deposits of rare minerals beneath the scorched surface, but no technology exists that could extract them without being torn apart by the planet’s own fury.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Comodin
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The wreckage of Comodin, flown by Silvio Queiroz. A raider from Cadiz, Queiroz made a name for himself through daring raids against Bretonian shipping in Cambridge and New London. Known for a particularly reckless flight style that threw his enemies off-balance, Queiroz was eventually chosen to join an elite raiding team, colloquially known as the Cerbero squadron.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Like the rest of his squadron, Queiroz was last seen trailing a Core convoy through the southern Omega systems.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The ship appears to have been ripped to pieces by heavy particle weapons, likely gunboat-grade. The data onboard the ship is only partially preserved. The log entries suggest Queiroz, together with his wingman, Gaviota, ambushed a Core gunboat traversing the system. The bold fighting style employed by Comodin backfired, a reckless strafing run bringing him right in front of the enemy vessel.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Maulwurf 1
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The lead ship of the Maulwurf wing, flown by Sebastian Enzenauer. Originally working for Daumann as a Diamond prospector in Omega-11, Enzenauer became disillusioned by the corporation’s treatment of himself and his fellow workers. Like many before, it would lead him to abandon his employer in favour of the Independent Miners Guild, where his skills as a surveyor would find him plenty of work on Omega-7’s Silver fields. As Enzenauer climbed the Guild’s ranks, he would end up attracting a small group of like-minded pilots, eventually forming the Maulwurfs.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Maulwurf wing began its life as an IMG prospecting team, credited with finding many previously-unknown Silver deposits in the depths of Omega-7. However, during one of their prospecting runs in the mid 831 AS, the team ran into an ambush set by Daumann-affiliated mercenaries. Kitted out for sampling rather than combat, the Maulwurfs suffered many casualties during their escape attempt - only three of the seven members managed to make it back to Freistadt. Enraged by their losses, the Maulwurfs soon left the Guild and joined up with the Hessians, seeking to avenge their fallen comrades.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Their final assignment was much like their previous work, the wing tasked with prospecting the systems of Omega-47 and Omega-55 for potential resource deposits. In their last communication, the wing relayed they were following a Corsair raiding party into an uncharted system. None of the Maulwurfs would return from the chase.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Most of the ship’s damage appears to be of environmental origin, its hull panels warped by high temperatures and intense radiation, but also pockmarked with laser and neutron weapon impacts. Analysis suggests the vessel suffered a gradual build up of damage over multiple engagements, the ship subsequently succumbing to the field it presumably used to conceal its retreat. The ship’s damaged equipment and the pilot’s body are still present.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Maulwurf 3
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The remains of Maulwurf 3, flown by Jordan Allen. Born onboard Holman Outpost, Allen was one of the only two Maulwurfs who began their career flying for the Guild. After spending his early years working maintenance on the ice miners from Holman, Allen would be forced to flee for the Omegas during the Gallic War. He would find work as a mechanic on Aland Shipyard, and would continue to work there until the station’s seizure by Bretonia.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Like many other members of the Guild, Allen was enraged by the transgression, enlisting with Freistadt’s security wings shortly after. However, he would not be able to finish his flight training before the conflict over Aland fizzled out. Instead, Allen’s freshly acquired training and years of technical expertise made him a prime recruit for the Maulwurf wing.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The ship appears to have been destroyed in just a few, pinpoint accurate salvos of plasma and neutron weapons fire. The damage is consistent with armaments used by Corsairs. The ship’s blackbox did not survive the encounter.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Ensis
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The remains of Ensis, the lead escort of the ill-fated Edenvale Expedition. Captained by commander Jesse Reilly, the Ensis and its crew were veterans of the Omega theatre. First deployed in 829 AS, the Ensis was put under the command of freshly promoted Reilly right out of the drydock.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The vessel would spend the entirety of its service life assigned to Dagger Outpost, supporting patrol and raider wings against Corsairs and Coalition forces alike. Both the captain and the crew would earn themselves a reputation for a spotless, if unremarkable, service record.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Ensis appears to have succumbed to numerous impacts from weaponry inflicted by unknown entities, the vessel clearly proving too large to effectively navigate a field this hostile. The radiation-induced loss of data prevents a full blackbox recovery, although an analysis of the remaining information indicates the Ensis attempted to use the field to shake off a group of pursuers. Evidently, the gambit has failed.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Docking Ring
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>>>>WARNING: Do not attempt planetary landing without using a Docking Ring.<<<</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>A docking ring is a piece of orbiting technology that, through the use of super strong crystalline polymers and frictionless bearings, assists the smooth atmospheric entry of any interstellar vessel that has the ability to land. Invented in 130 AS by Ageira Technologies, these 'orbital elevators' almost completely negate the cost of boosting people or materials out of a planetary gravity well. Docking rings revolutionized exploration and industry almost overnight, opening up entire systems for commercial exploration and exploitation.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ageira Technologies licenses this technology to the other houses, who in turn agree to design all ships (except for special exploratory and survey vessels), to work with the docking ring system.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Burgundy Jump Hole
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Vierlande Wreck
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>CLASS: Abbey </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>GRAVITY: N/A</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>DOCKING: No</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>AMENITIES: None</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>CREW: 0</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>INMATES: 0</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Vierlande Prison was built in 715 AS and breached in 826 AS. For over one hundred years, its extreme conditions made it one of the most dreaded destinations for Rheinland's terrorists and political prisoners. Sentences to Vierlande were almost always for life, with those few discharged forever changed. With the Rheinland Military distracted by the Saigon War, a force consisting of the Coalition, Red Hessians and Unioners took advantage of a lapse in security to capture the station, indiscriminately releasing the thousands of inmates within.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>During the victory celebrations, the Coalition and Red Hessians turned on their former allies, accusing the Unioners of collaboration with the Corsairs. The Coalition Carrier Alvin Katz and Hessian Battleship Zuschen took the Unioner flagship Undine by surprise, destroying it and scattering her escorts. As the Coalition and Hessians withdrew, surviving Unioners reoccupied the Prison. Despite some probing attacks by outgunned RFP patrols, they successfully converted the base into a smuggling way-station, and front line against further Hessian attacks.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>During the Civil War, Imperial forces would turn a blind eye to the Unioner occupation of the prison, seeing them as a useful irregular force. Despite this, tolerance of Unioner piracy would quickly wane, with the post-war armistice offered to the Unioners almost immediately collapsing in 829 AS. In one of the first military operations of the new Consensus Government, the Battleship Kolleda was dispatched to 'deconstruct' the station, with the Unioners hastily retreating rather than fighting the Military head-on.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Sealed Orkney Jump Gate
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>This Gallic Jump Gate was constructed by EFL Oil & Machinery in 744 AGS (828 AS), following the Kusari Invasion of Gallia. The Treaty of Rishiri setting out the terms of peace conceded Gallia's access to Tau-23. The Gallic Union then authorized the construction of a Gate connection to Orkney as an alternate route to the resources of the Hebrides. The Gate was abruptly disabled and sealed by the Gallic Navy in 745 AGS (829 AS), following a "security incident" in Orkney.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Oblique
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>CLASS: Charlemagne</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>CREW: N/A</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ARMAMENT: N/A</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Charlemagne battleships were designed around 676 AGS (760 AS), specifically for defensive and support purposes. Battleships of this class were configured to hold and maintain large numbers of fighters and cover them with powerful point defense turrets. By the time of the Gallic invasion of Bretonia, the dated Charlemagnes were used as the rearguard for advancing forces and for protecting vulnerable supply lines.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Originally a warship of the Gallic Royal Navy, the Battleship Oblique was tasked with garrisoning occupied Tau-44 against Crayter and Council attacks. The Oblique and her fleet shockingly deserted to The Council in 732 AGS (822 AS), after receiving brutal orders to execute the remaining Crayter civilians and prisoners of war being held on Borneo. The fleet played a key role in liberating the system, before moving on to participate in the Council's campaigns across Burgundy. In 741 AGS (825 AS), the Oblique was dispatched south to establish a new front and capture Provence -- opening another direction of attack on Ile-de-France.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The battleship and her forces hid in the Mer Mediterrainee, skirmishing with the system garrison commanded by the Battleship Arles. Late in the year, the Oblique was reinforced by Council survivors from Roussillon. During the so-called "Clash of the Titans", both the Arles and the Oblique were destroyed outright. The Council's depleted forces retreated to Champagne, and the crippled Royal garrison fell back to Ile-de-France -- creating the power vacuum later exploited by The Minarchy. The wreckage of the Oblique, however, remained -- its unspent ordinance and molten hull plating raining down upon Planet Marseille. EFL is now working to salvage the Oblique's wreckage, however progress has been glacially slow.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Tau-37 Jump Hole
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Planet Malta
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 13,534 km.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 6.02 x 10e24 kg.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Terrestrial</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: -23°C to 31°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 12.69 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Vesuvius
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 4,912 km </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 2.010 x 10e24 kg </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Volcanic </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: -188°C to 513°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 3.27 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>A hot, rocky, and heavy moon in a semi-inclined orbit above Malta, Vesuvius is the result of an approximately 30 million year old collision of two captured asteroids, that has been cooling off ever since. Said asteroids were likely destined to impact Malta, but said cataclysm was staved off when the two met, forming Malta's only natural satellite and "guardian angel" that has protected the world from collisions ever since. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Though portions of Vesuvius are still prominent volcanic features, there are a small number of shielded settlements in the form of research outposts on, and below the surface. An 816 census put the population of the moon at no more than 600, most of which are centered around the planet's lone spaceport near the equator.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Planet Mallorca
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 19,450 km</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 10.04 x 10e24 kg</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: N/A</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: N/A</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 17.02 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Little is known about the frozen gas giant Mallorca. Mostly likely composition is frozen methane mixed with unknown trace gases. </TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Prenta
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 8,500 km</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 4.74 x 10e24 kg</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Barren</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: -75°C to -34°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 9.72 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>A rocky, airless moon, pockmarked by asteroid impact craters.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Planet Carinea
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 21,891 km</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 7.32 x 10e24 kg</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Terrestrial</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: 4°C to 39°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 16.23 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>>>>RESTRICTED<<<</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>An oddity in the annals of human exploration. While initial surveys indicated a seemingly idyllic world of thick forests and low fogs, the first expeditions to make planetfall quickly learned that an essential component of the planetary ecology was a fast-acting organic poison fatal to human beings. Every plant and animal examined on the planet contained this poison to one degree or another and any plans for settlement were quickly abandoned.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Planet Albegna
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 10,289 km</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 8.12 x 10e24 kg</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Desert</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: -25°C to 83°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 7.80 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Albegna is a desert world with a thin atmosphere comprised of mainly carbon dioxide (96%) and trace amounts of argon and nitrogen. While initial surveys detected little to no precious metals on the surface, more thorough scans revealed the presence of large deposits of Titanium and veins of more precious metals within the planet's crust. As a result, the Outcasts elected to establish an underground colony.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Despite the colony's purpose as a mining outpost and military facility, further study is being carried out to address the possibility of terraforming the planet using massive bodies of water provided by comets or ice asteroids found in abundance in the Tau-37 system. </TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Valletta Mooring Terminal
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Valletta Mooring Terminal serves as the central trading hub of Omicron Alpha. It is primarily used for loading and unloading cargo, refitting ships, and providing emergency servicing for Outcast military vessels too large to land on Malta.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>With the Cardamine trade stabilizing after the Maltese slave revolt, the terminal has returned to being busy and active, bringing wealth to the Maltese people.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Santa Verna Wreck
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>CLASS: Apagado </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>GRAVITY: None</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>DOCKING: No</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>AMENITIES: No</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>CREW: 0, Formerly 360</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Santa Verna was carved into a large asteroid within the mysterious cloud known as the Zonas Sagradas, originally intended to serve as a listening station for the early, vulnerable society on the planet Malta. As rumors spread about unknown entities and anomalies within this cloud, Santa Verna gradually became a pilgrimage site for spiritual individuals and sects from Malta.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Although this development stirred disapproval among the more secular-minded strata on Malta, there was never an official ban on the practices at Santa Verna. Over the centuries, these practices slowly expanded as the station transformed into an ornately decorated shrine, visited even by some non-Outcast pilgrims seeking spiritual enlightenment.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The end of the shrine came in 831 AS during the Slave Rebellion, which affected the local population as well. Although the uprising was seemingly quickly suppressed, a small group of slaves managed to sabotage the communication systems and life support, leading to the demise of the crew before anyone could come to their aid.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Santa Verna was never restored -- instead, Malta decided to transform this unique and hauntingly adorned shrine into a sacred necropolis. Here, wealthy and influential Outcasts may lay themselves to eternal rest, preserving their physical bodies from the ravages of time for all eternity.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Omega-41 Jump Hole
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Our only competitor is the Stokes Smelter in Leeds. BMM is using outdated production methods which are less cost effective than ours, so we are confident that ALG will soon own all of this market. </TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Battleship Barcelona
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Dreadnought Barcelona was the pinnacle of Corsair imperial ambition, intended to serve as an armored fist smashing through enemies in the Omegas and Sigmas. For this purpose, it was outfitted with the most modern and advanced weaponry available in 820 AS. For Crete, Barcelona was such a critical project that part of its systems required technical expertise from the Order.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>However, these ambitions were never fully realized, mainly due to the Order's reluctance to assist the Corsairs in operationalizing such a dangerous vessel. This led to never-ending technical issues and complicated maintenance. Instead of becoming the steel fist leading Corsair armies, Barcelona was merely a mobile base in the Sigmas.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The final nail in the coffin for this battleship was an attempt to deploy it in Sigma-17 in 830 AS against the Outcasts, a task it ultimately failed to accomplish due to its unreliable systems. Shortly after that, due to the Prox's ability to perform Barcelona's job more efficiently, it was decided to decommission and scrap the ship. While the story of this majestic vessel is a sad one, the experiences gained from its operation and systems led to the development of much more efficient and deadly ships - the Tribunus-class battlecruisers.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Skiros Wreck
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Skiros was built in 816-817 AS using mostly materials either stolen or looted from various convoys and sites, Freeport 7 among them. Heavily defended due to its location in the heart of the Corsair Empire, Skiros fulfulls several functions, some of which being maintenance of space ships and food production. Due to its biodome, Skiros has picked up the interest of several influential figures within Corsair society who either want the produced food for their own ships or to study the architecture of it to maybe allow other Corsair installations to produce their own food -- and maybe one day solve one of the biggest problems associated with spaceborne travel. The station however was abandoned following the spread of influence over the Zoners of Theta.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Thales Anomaly
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Discovered by the renowned Corsair explorer Claudia Fuentes in 455 AS, the Thales Anomaly has become a central focus for the Corsair scientific community, drawing scientists and researchers from across the Imperio. The anomaly emits unusual pulses in a strangely consistent and predictable pattern, allowing a small fraction of its energy to be harvested for research purposes.</TEXT><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Because the origin of the anomaly's source matter remains unknown, the harvested energy has yet to find practical applications. Nevertheless, the crew aboard the nearby research station continue to study and experiment with it, driven by the hope of unlocking the next great scientific breakthrough.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Official records had claimed the convoy was destroyed by Farmers Alliance terrorists.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

Official records had claimed the convoy was destroyed by Farmers Alliance terrorists.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: IKN Niyodo
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The wreck of a Kusari Naval Forces battlecruiser captained by Isamu Kojima. The Niyodo was last sighted in 832 AS at Kansai Research Institute, departing on special assignment. The Niyodo appears to have been fitted with heavily modified, experimental propulsion and drive systems. The battlecruiser looks to have taken extensive damage from heavy weapons fire, breaking apart under the barrage. Many of the crew launched life pods, but ultimately depleted their fuel and life support. The ship's drive core has been crudely extracted and is now missing.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: IKN Yamafaku Maru
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The wreck of a Kusari Naval Forces auxiliary transport captained by Hokama Takao. The Yamafaku Maru was last sighted in 832 AS at Kansai Research Institute, departing on special assignment. The Yamafaku Maru appears to have been configured as a fuel carrier, with its cargo detonating after taking heavy weapons fire.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: LNS Fairmont
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The wreck of a modern Liberty Navy dreadnought captained by Adrian Keller. The Fairmont was last sighted in 826 AS, transiting into the Alberta Supergate during the Gallic War. With the gate’s sabotage, the Whitefield, Fairmont and supporting battlegroups were lost, presumed destroyed. Stranded Liberty Navy personnel appear to have congregated aboard the Fairmont before its life support was eventually depleted.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: LNS Whitefield
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The wreck of a veteran Liberty Navy dreadnought captained by Hannah Enriquez. The Whitefield was last sighted in 826 AS, transiting into the Alberta Supergate during the Gallic War. With the gate’s sabotage, the Whitefield, Fairmont and supporting battlegroups were lost, presumed destroyed. The Whitefield appears to have been stripped, scuttled, and abandoned.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: LNS Aurora
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The wreck of a Liberty Navy gunboat captained by Michael Frost. The Aurora was last sighted in 826 AS, transiting into the Alberta Supergate during the Gallic War. With the gate’s sabotage, the Whitefield, Fairmont and supporting battlegroups were lost, presumed destroyed. The Aurora appears to have gone AWOL from its battlegroup, venturing deeper into the unknown before depleting its fuel and life support.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: RNS Alsace
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The wreck of a Royal Navy battleship captained by Silvain Bettencourt. The Alsace was last sighted in 826 AS, leading a flotilla of mutinous Royalist warships away from the glassing of Leeds. The Alsace appears to have suffered a catastrophic containment breach from heavy weapons fire, leaving only the burnt husk of its fore section as remains.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Bering -> Texas
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>A jump gate is a conveyance technology that allows instantaneous travel between two distinct points in space using technology pioneered by Ageira Technologies and built by Deep Space Engineering in 130 AS. According to the annual Ageira Technologies Shareholder Report, 'jump gate technology is designed to gather and amplify certain permeable tendencies in real-space and connect them to other congruent points elsewhere in the sector, while still maintaining the structural integrity and stability of the channel created by this process and of the object passing through it.'</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering continue to survey other potential jump point candidates and expect to provide connections with other areas further and further away as their research continues.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Storage Depot
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>A storage depot typically houses a wide range of commodities in preparation for transport.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Hudson Jump Hole
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. objects.name: Freeport 2
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Built out of the old framework of an abandoned Republican Shipping outpost, Freeport 2 was founded in 650 AS by displaced Texas settlers, Hamburg drifters, and a variety of other individuals looking for safe haven. They aligned themselves with the Zoner movement and its open-to-all philosophy, then purchased a series of Synth Foods biodomes for Food production. The exploding demand for Food from the adjacent Texas System and from local criminal elements had provided them with a steady market for their surplus until the onset of the Hudson  War in 817 AS.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>After trade ceased, Freeport 2 fell into obscurity. Those aboard clung desperately to the faint hope that trade would resume with the ending of hostilities and restore the Freeport to its previous state -- the destruction of the Hamburg Jump Gate in 819 AS dashed this possibility. After Liberty withdrew at the war’s end, the steadily rising number of lawless visitors began to threaten the station's denizens. When the governments of Liberty and Rheinland focused reconstruction efforts on Hudson, Bering -- and all those within -- to fade into shadow.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Facing poverty and violent coercion, the Zoners of Freeport 2 began to leave their former home little by little. By 824 AS, the population of the Freeport had gradually shifted until only a handful of its original inhabitants remained. Before long, pirate gangs subdued the remaining Zoners and took full control, brazenly broadcasting their colors. The pirates of Freeport 2 would not last however. In 827 AS, the Liberty Navy launched the Scouring of Bering: Freeport 2 was brutally put to the sword as the Battleship Concord’s fleet rampaged towards the Seperatist stronghold of Marshall Station.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Planet Atka
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 13,100 km</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 6.72 x 10e24 kg</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Arctic</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: -50°C to -10°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 10.02 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The frozen planet of Atka is currently being terraformed by Liberty, with the long-term objective of resettling manufacturing jobs and Houston undesirables into the Independent Worlds. From the first surveys in the 770s, the plan has been a controversial one. Despite decades of negotiations between Rheinland and Liberty on the matter, Rheinland never agreed to sell their consent for the move, insisting the system remain a neutral buffer.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In 816 AS, Liberty grew tired of this impasse, and unilaterally contracted Planetform to build Cold Bay Depot in orbit. Rheinland was outraged by the move, and ordered the station’s immediate deconstruction. This dispute escalated out of control, resulting in the Hudson War. The Treaty of Atka ended the conflict in 823 AS. Rheinland agreed to cede Atka to Liberty, and in exchange -- desperate to end the war and focus on the Gallic threat -- Liberty committed to underwrite 85% of the reconstruction costs for the Jump Gates to Hamburg, and assist with stabilizing Rheinland’s damaged economy.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Rheinland’s sanctions on Planetform have now been removed, allowing work to resume in earnest. The company believes that constructing orbital mirrors and releasing Terraforming Gasses into the atmosphere will increase the surface temperature by 30 degrees within a century. It is expected most of the surface will thaw, creating a temperate ocean world of scattered archipelagos.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Shotoku
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>This wreckage appears riddled with scorch marks and the gradual erosion caused by intense radiation. Downloading the manifest proves insightful, if frustrating at first, since the drives warn you repeatedly that the data within is the proprietary property of Kishiro.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>This ship is, or perhaps was, the Shotoku, and had been on a top-level assignment to deliver weapon prototypes to Liberty. The exact nature of this agreement, as well as details on what the weapons may have been are all lost to data corruption. But the manifest does thoroughly detail the security protocols, as well as the names and backgrounds of the pilots that would be escorting it. The ship was intended to be escorted by the Naval Forces from the Shikoku Jump Gate and towards trade lanes leading to Colorado. It would have then been escorted by an element of the Liberty Navy for the rest of the journey.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Evident from the ship's current state, and the lack of any further wreckage to suggest that its escorts perished in the Shotoku's defense, the circumstances surrounding its fate here are a mystery.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Planet Veracruz
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Planet Veracruz was the sole inhabited world of the Vespucci system, and previous seat of power for the Commonwealth of Liberty - an independent civilian government formed by the Hellfire Legion in 822 AS. Veracruz was a harsh frontier world, complicating early colonisation attempts. Its various administrations had attempted to develop local industrial capacity, however a lack of civilian specialists and interference by the Gaian movement impeded these efforts. A large portion of Veracruz's population was composed of destitute Bretonian refugees, who were relied upon as a cheap labor force. This caused the schism with the previously allied Xeno movement, who accused the Commonwealth - and later Insurgency - of betraying its Libertonian roots. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Following the disastrous Scouring of Bering in 827 AS, the newly formed Liberty Insurgency launched a coup and reasserted military rule. The junta's heavy handed governance and imposition of martial law would cause increasing civil unrest, resulting in riots that were brutally suppressed. This period of repression and a string of defeats against the Liberty Navy prompted many to flee the planet, with thousands heading to Planet Erie in Pennsylvania. In early 829 AS, the Liberty Navy broke through the Insurgency's Kansas defences and launched its final assault on Vespucci itself. After the gruelling battle to dispatch Marshall Station, Liberty's forces discovered Veracruz largely depopulated, save for Insurgency marines who had vowed to die in their fortifications before surrendering. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Carrier Ohio and its battlegroup elected not to land troops to contest the surface, instead carrying out weeks of devastating saturation bombardment. This attack was carried out methodically to erase any large settlements or infrastructure that might assist future parties with colonising the world. Several monitoring probes were placed in orbit to ensure Veracruz remained undisturbed in the future, with DSE being awarded a maintenance contract for the network. Veracruz's colonies are now little more than shattered rubble, and a monument to the Insurgency's grand but ultimately futile ambitions.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Mooring Fixture
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>A mooring fixture is a temporary resting area for idle ships within active shipping zones, allowing transports and other large vessels to be unloaded and passengers transferred.  </TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Battlecruiser Triton
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Battlecruiser Triton became the last surviving heavy warship in the Insurgency's brutalized armada, and it would be forced to face off against the Delaware's own formation that had superior numbers but lacked the cohesion and determination that its opposition did.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>This ultimately spelled the Delaware's doom and cut short any notion of this campaign being an ideal victory for Liberty. In effect, the Insurgency's surviving forces did exactly what they had hoped for in this situation, showcasing the image of an immortal Liberty as a lie.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Despite this achievement, the Triton suffered catastrophic damage, and its Commanding Officer died from blood loss after shrapnel had wounded him during the engagement with the Delaware. The ship was little more than a drifting hulk by the time the Ohio managed to finish what the Delaware should have waited for.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Fort Leniex
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Fort Leniex was originally constructed in utmost secrecy as a fallback point and bastion for the Hellfire Legion. Used as both a HQ and the main shipyard for the Legion's military forces, Leniex has been consistently expanded over the course of many years. Leniex housed a large proportion of the Legion's senior officers prior to the devastation of the scouring of Bering.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Fort possesses several warship berths capable of constructing the infamous Arbiter class battleship, as well as the facilities to service and maintain said ships. Due to Leniex's role as a central command structure, it was equipped with extensive communications arrays, and was heavily guarded through both internal security features and a significant garrison fleet.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>When the Insurgency was formed, Leniex sided with what remained of the Legion's Military High Command instead of the Commonwealth civilian government. The local garrison moved quickly to secure the surrounding system, a task that was largely accomplished before Commonwealth reinforcements from Monterrey arrived. After a brief battle, the system was subdued and Leniex formally appointed as the HQ for the new Insurgency.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Fort Leniex continued functioning as a military HQ for the Insurgency until the middle of 829 AS, when the Liberty Navy forces had managed to break through the Insurgent heavy defenses and managed to reach planet Veracruz.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>As the situation was hopeless and supplies were running low, the Insurgency High Command had issued the order to evacuate and scuttle Fort Leniex so it would not fall into enemy hands. Unbeknownst to them, not all of the demolition charges had been successfully detonated and a large portion of the station remained intact, but with a majority of its once extensive ship producing facilities irreparably damaged, Leniex is now the relic of a bygone era.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Insurgency Cruiser
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA bold="true"/><JUST loc="center"/><TEXT>Insurgency "Judicator" Cruiser</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TRA bold="default"/><JUST loc="left"/><TEXT>The third of the new ship projects put into action by Reynard Joyeuse before he departed, the Judicator Cruiser was originally designed with the Insurgency's typical modus operandi in mind - heavy assault. The ship saw several complications in its inception however, and while mass production was put on hold, the Judicator changed to fit the times that the Insurgency was facing.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Initially built around a massive experimental beam weapon, this system was gutted in favor of expanded fighter facilities, more suited for the Insurgency's more recent patrols of the neighboring systems. Other notable features include a large centrifuge to supply extra power to other systems while still giving quarters of the ship gravity and a redundant engine array system, supposedly nigh impossible to disable.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Young Legionnaires often breathe a sigh of relief after being assigned to a Judicator as they are most often relegated to backwater patrols, in addition to being considered one of the safer vessels in the Insurgency's arsenal.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Yuma Docking Ring
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>>>>WARNING: Do not attempt planetary landing without using a Docking Ring.<<<</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>A docking ring is a piece of orbiting technology that, through the use of super strong crystalline polymers and frictionless bearings, assists the smooth atmospheric entry of any interstellar vessel that has the ability to land. Invented in 130 AS by Ageira Technologies, these 'orbital elevators' almost completely negate the cost of boosting people or materials out of a planetary gravity well. Docking rings revolutionized exploration and industry almost overnight, opening up entire systems for commercial exploration and exploitation.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ageira Technologies licenses this technology to the other houses, who in turn agree to design all ships (except for special exploratory and survey vessels), to work with the docking ring system.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Coronado -> Cortez
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>A jump gate is a conveyance technology that allows instantaneous travel between two distinct points in space using technology pioneered by Ageira Technologies and built by Deep Space Engineering in 130 AS. According to the annual Ageira Technologies Shareholder Report, 'jump gate technology is designed to gather and amplify certain permeable tendencies in real-space and connect them to other congruent points elsewhere in the sector, while still maintaining the structural integrity and stability of the channel created by this process and of the object passing through it.'</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering continue to survey other potential jump point candidates and expect to provide connections with other areas further and further away as their research continues.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Cortez Jump Hole
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Kyushu Jump Hole
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: New Tokyo Docking Ring
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>>>>WARNING: Do not attempt planetary landing without using a Docking Ring.<<<</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>A docking ring is a piece of orbiting technology that, through the use of super strong crystalline polymers and frictionless bearings, assists the smooth atmospheric entry of any interstellar vessel that has the ability to land. Invented in 130 AS by Ageira Technologies, these 'orbital elevators' almost completely negate the cost of boosting people or materials out of a planetary gravity well. Docking rings revolutionized exploration and industry almost overnight, opening up entire systems for commercial exploration and exploitation.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ageira Technologies licenses this technology to the other houses, who in turn agree to design all ships (except for special exploratory and survey vessels), to work with the docking ring system.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Roppongi Wreck
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>In the early years of the Kusari Shogunate, foreign immigration was strictly controlled and permanent foreign settlement on New Tokyo were strictly forbidden. While the Shogunate was unwilling to bend these rules, it still accommodated foreign business interests by constructing Roppongi Station in 318 AS. Roppongi quickly became home to large numbers of elite repatriates from New York and New London who had long term business interests in Kusari. Roppongi later became the focal point of the 521 AS Kusari-Rhienland Nationalization Crisis, when both Houses seized their Trade Lanes and Jump Gates, expelling Interspace Commerce in the process.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Interspace was permitted to return in the aftermath of the 80-Years War between Rheinland and the GMG, owing to financial transactions between Kusari and Liberty and quickly established several major offices on Roppongi. By the time of the short-lived Kusari Republic, many of the restrictions on foreign companies had been lifted in the interests of progress. Roppongi became a busy trade center and luxury concourse, bustling with corporations, local celebrities and thronging crowds of New Tokyo socialites. Most of the major houses maintained their Kusari embassies or consular services aboard.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In 832 AS, a nuclear dirty bomb was detonated in the station’s lower hangars. Although emergency bulkheads were able to prevent complete disintegration, the interior was heavily irradiated and swept by fires that smoldered for months after. The attack provoked immediate outrage from the other Houses due to the heavy loss of life, and the destruction of embassy facilities. Kusari now faces intense pressure to crack down on the Farmer’s Alliance, who claimed responsibility for the attack. As of 834 AS, Samura Heavy Industries is leading efforts to decontaminate and dismantle the station.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Kyushu Jump Hole
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Junyo Docking Ring
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>>>>WARNING: Do not attempt planetary landing without using a Docking Ring.<<<</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>A docking ring is a piece of orbiting technology that, through the use of super strong crystalline polymers and frictionless bearings, assists the smooth atmospheric entry of any interstellar vessel that has the ability to land. Invented in 130 AS by Ageira Technologies, these 'orbital elevators' almost completely negate the cost of boosting people or materials out of a planetary gravity well. Docking rings revolutionized exploration and industry almost overnight, opening up entire systems for commercial exploration and exploitation.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ageira Technologies licenses this technology to the other houses, who in turn agree to design all ships (except for special exploratory and survey vessels), to work with the docking ring system.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Tau-23 Jump Hole
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Kyushu Docking Ring
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>>>>WARNING: Do not attempt planetary landing without using a Docking Ring.<<<</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>A docking ring is a piece of orbiting technology that, through the use of super strong crystalline polymers and frictionless bearings, assists the smooth atmospheric entry of any interstellar vessel that has the ability to land. Invented in 130 AS by Ageira Technologies, these 'orbital elevators' almost completely negate the cost of boosting people or materials out of a planetary gravity well. Docking rings revolutionized exploration and industry almost overnight, opening up entire systems for commercial exploration and exploitation.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ageira Technologies licenses this technology to the other houses, who in turn agree to design all ships (except for special exploratory and survey vessels), to work with the docking ring system.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Matsuda Wreck
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Battleship </TEXT><TRA data="2" mask="2" def="-3"/><TEXT>Himeji</TEXT><TRA data="0" mask="2" def="-1"/><TEXT> was originally stationed outside Heaven's Gate in the Tohoku system, serving alongside a guard fleet led by the Battleships </TEXT><TRA data="2" mask="2" def="-3"/><TEXT>Ishioka</TEXT><TRA data="0" mask="2" def="-1"/><TEXT>, </TEXT><TRA data="2" mask="2" def="-3"/><TEXT>Musashi</TEXT><TRA data="0" mask="2" def="-1"/><TEXT> and </TEXT><TRA data="2" mask="2" def="-3"/><TEXT>Sennan</TEXT><TRA data="0" mask="2" def="-1"/><TEXT>. At the peak of the Colony Wars in 800 AS, the Blood Dragons and The Order conducted an attack on the Arch, striking the </TEXT><TRA data="2" mask="2" def="-3"/><TEXT>Himeij</TEXT><TRA data="0" mask="2" def="-1"/><TEXT>’s bridge and engines. The surviving crew was forced to abandon ship, with the burning wreck assumed destroyed by both the Blood Dragons and Kusari.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Golden Chrysanthemum scouts encountered the wreck in a nearby asteroid field in 810 AS. The GC ultimately decided it was worth the expense of salvaging the ship, and with the assistance of their Blood Dragon allies, patched the engines to the point that it could safely leave the system. The vessel was then re-named '</TEXT><TRA data="2" mask="2" def="-3"/><TEXT>Matsuda</TEXT><TRA data="0" mask="2" def="-1"/><TEXT>', in honour of Yuyu Matsuda, founder of the Golden Chrysanthemum movement. Further restorations would occur in the Okinawa system with the assistance of Outcast engineers.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Entering full service in 825 AS, </TEXT><TRA data="2" mask="2" def="-3"/><TEXT>Matsuda</TEXT><TRA data="0" mask="2" def="-1"/><TEXT> would be deployed into Kyushu’s Seiran Dust Cloud as a forward raiding base. Later in 831 AS, the GC would find themselves pressured by the Outcasts to secure the Cardamine smuggling routes while they were preoccupied with the Maltese Slave Revolt. The </TEXT><TRA data="2" mask="2" def="-3"/><TEXT>Matsuda</TEXT><TRA data="0" mask="2" def="-1"/><TEXT> would take up position in Ohka Dust Cloud to better project patrols into Tau-23. Two years later, the </TEXT><TRA data="2" mask="2" def="-3"/><TEXT>Matsuda</TEXT><TRA data="0" mask="2" def="-1"/><TEXT> would be intercepted and destroyed by the Battleship </TEXT><TRA data="2" mask="2" def="-3"/><TEXT>Matsumoto</TEXT><TRA data="0" mask="2" def="-1"/><TEXT> while returning to Hokkaido for refitting.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

According to the annual Ageira Technologies Shareholder Report, 'jump gate technology is designed to gather and amplify certain permeable tendencies in real-space and connect them to other congruent points elsewhere in the sector, while still maintaining the structural integrity and stability of the channel created by this process and of the object passing through it.'</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering continue to survey other potential jump point candidates and expect to provide connections with other areas further and further away as their research continues.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Hokkaido Jump Hole
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Honshu Docking Ring
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="65281" mask="-31" def="30"/><TEXT>>>>WARNING: Do not attempt planetary landing without using a Docking Ring.<<<</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="96" mask="-31" def="-1"/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>A docking ring is a piece of orbiting technology that, through the use of super strong crystalline polymers and frictionless bearings, assists the smooth atmospheric entry of any interstellar vessel that has the ability to land. Invented in 130 AS by Ageira Technologies, these 'orbital elevators' almost completely negate the cost of boosting people or materials out of a planetary gravity well. Docking rings revolutionized exploration and industry almost overnight, opening up entire systems for commercial exploration and exploitation.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ageira Technologies licenses this technology to the other houses, who in turn agree to design all ships (except for special exploratory and survey vessels), to work with the docking ring system.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Trade lanes are the fastest and safest method of transporting goods and personnel within and between the colonies. Plans to expand the trade lanes to connect interests in the independent territories outside of the colonies are pending.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

objects.name: Hokkaido -> New Tokyo
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>A jump gate is a conveyance technology that allows instantaneous travel between two distinct points in space using technology pioneered by Ageira Technologies and built by Deep Space Engineering in 130 AS. According to the annual Ageira Technologies Shareholder Report, 'jump gate technology is designed to gather and amplify certain permeable tendencies in real-space and connect them to other congruent points elsewhere in the sector, while still maintaining the structural integrity and stability of the channel created by this process and of the object passing through it.'</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering continue to survey other potential jump point candidates and expect to provide connections with other areas further and further away as their research continues.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
